name: Edit Fields
label: Set / keep JSON fields
description: In-process JSON field editor. Sets, keeps, or emits a rebuilt object. No network. File refs pass through as type file when include_binary is true.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Edit Fields operation. Set operation (or rely on config). Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: 'set'.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: Array of maps, JSON strings ({"path","value"}), or path=value strings. Bare path under set removes that leaf. Invalid entries return INVALID_INPUT.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Optional file ref when include_binary is true. Type file (platform ref-id).

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`/`data`). Secrets redacted. File-producing ops also set `file` (type file). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Result file ref when the operation produces a file. Type file (platform ref-id). Never inline bytes.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload (parsed JSON or engine result). Absent when unused.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status when the op is an official HTTP call. Absent for in-process ops.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: set | keep_set | json_output. Required. Example: 'set'.

configurationParameters.label: Fields
configurationParameters.description: JSON array of {path, value} or keep-list. Optional default when input omits fields.

configurationParameters.label: Include Binary
configurationParameters.description: Pass file-typed refs through. EXACT false|true. Default false.

configurationParameters.label: Dot Notation
configurationParameters.description: Treat paths as dotted keys. EXACT false|true. Default true.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read / run budget in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Keep at or below the sandbox request budget. Example: 25.
